tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi bstod pa/ /

bde gshegs yab yum lnga lnga nus ma bcu/ /sems pa sems ma drug drug khro bo bcu/ /lha chen bcu gnyis klu dang rnal 'byor ma/ /rab gtum ma rnams brgyad brgyad thabs shes bcas/ /pad+ma gdan bcas brgya dang lnga bcu drug |'dab ma'i lha mo bzhi brgya nyer bzhir bcas/ /kun kyang gzhan rig thabs shes sbyar ba yis/ /dus 'khor rtsa ba'i lha grangs stong dang bzhi/ /mngon brjod lha mo so drug thabs bcas dang*/ /phyag rgya drug bcas gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ /ma gtogs lo gsum zhags grangs stong brgyad bcu/ /lo gsum nyi ma'i lha la phyag mtshal lo/ /dgu dang bcu gsum bcu dgu nyi shu lnga| |so gnyis so bzhi dpal ldan 'dus pa drug/zhe gsum zhe lnga zhe dgu dra ba gsum/ /thabs shes bcas shing gtso bo yab yum bcas/ /lnga brgya bzhi bcu phyogs gsum zhag grangs la/ /nyi khyim gyis bsgyur phyogs gsum zla ba'i lha| |bsdoms grangs stong dang drug brgya nyi shu pa/ /dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal// // stag lo'i bka' 'bum/dus 'khor gyi skor/ rgyu skar gyi bstod pa/ -PAGE 324-PAGE 313- PAGE 318-
